author: agent:claude-code
message: vg-dotfiles-windows' grafts 01a165b4 (wallpaper slideshow) and 01a165bb (Claude Code profiles on every archetype), which the user asked to do; hyprpaper.conf moved to 0.8 syntax on the way (proposal 01a165cf-7cfb-7614-9994-80be73517566, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: wallpapers
intent: The desktop wallpaper as a shuffled slideshow over the vg-wallpapers clone, a new image every 30 minutes, filling the screen, on every Nix desktop (Hyprland, Plasma, GNOME, macOS), with the same settings as Windows.

text: Each desktop runs the slideshow its own way, from one set of settings
why: common.wallpapers (folder, minutes) is the one owner. hyprpaper 0.8 cycles a folder itself (timeout, order = random-shuffle, fit_mode = cover), so Hyprland gets a generated wallpaper block and no script; Plasma's own slideshow is pointed at the folder at login through busctl evaluateScript (SlideshowMode 0 random, FillMode 2 crop), busctl rather than Qt's qdbus to keep Qt out of the closure; GNOME (gsettings, zoom) and macOS (System Events, a launchd agent) have no slideshow, so `vg-wallpaper` picks a random image other than the one showing. Off on headless hosts and NixOS-WSL. Verified: evaluation of every host, the generated hyprpaper block, autostart entries and launchd agent, and wallpaper.test.sh (pick logic in throwaway folders, 8 checks, in CI). Not yet run on a desktop: the Plasma script values and the GNOME/macOS setters are untested on hardware.

title: hyprpaper.conf was still in the pre-0.8 syntax after the 26.05 upgrade
body: 26.05 ships hyprpaper 0.8.4, which only reads `wallpaper { monitor path fit_mode timeout order }` blocks; the old `preload =` / `wallpaper = ,path` lines would have left vgkraken without a wallpaper (never caught: evaluation doesn't parse runtime configs, and Hyprland hasn't run there yet). Moved to 0.8 syntax with the block sourced from a generated file. Lesson: after a release upgrade, check the live-edited configs of apps whose major version moved, not only the nix evaluation.

text: Every machine has the personal and work profiles, named as on Windows
why: vg-dotfiles-windows' graft 01a165bb: the same names and dirs everywhere, so a session started on one machine is found on another with the same profile. Profiles default to [ personal work ] (a host lists one or none); `claude` is personal, `claude-work` pins work; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR = ~/.claude-<name> (was ~/.local/share/claude-profiles/<name>; activation moves an old dir when the new one doesn't exist, never overwriting); every wrapper clears CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Bare `claude` keeps following a direnv-set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which Windows has no counterpart for. Applied on vgwsl2: dirs moved, wrappers tested with a stand-in binary (personal, work forced, token cleared, direnv dir honored).
